controls.prediction_to_refine_and_seal: Replace the divergence-matched proof field by an incorrect constant/gradient substitute; a concrete form or pointwise identity must detect the missing source term.
Use an unmatched radial core profile; detect the derivative/interface error while the original profile passes.
Violate the pair-nonnegativity or kinetic hypothesis in a toy member; the claimed full interacting lower must refuse that transfer.
Omit log derivative or signed off-diagonal Gram/kinetic terms; detect a changed exact integral or invalid normalization on a declared witness.
Use nonorthogonal occupied states or exceed spin multiplicity without a valid Gram normalization; detect the invalid Pauli trace.
Retain the regular-basis and genuine full-cross-term computations as comparisons; numerical optimization alone must not replace a directed witness check.
Substitute one shared occupied coefficient for different prefixes or one wrong coupling/source factor; detect a selected phase/binding discrepancy.
Drop the intrinsic gap or core self from one complete minimum; detect the changed/unsupported reference claim on a source-bound comparison.
Present finite-core, ionization or massive-action results as the original point-source account; the source contract must reject the transfer.

policy: Predictions refined and sealed before execution; a control that does not break as predicted is retained and reported.
